run_generate_headers: run the script to generate C++ header files from a Boost Metaparse getting started qbk guide
parse_metashell_definitions: parse a qbk documentation file to extract metashell command definitions and numbered sections
generate_section_headers: generate incremental C++ header files with include guards for each documentation section
extract_code_snippets: extract copy-paste friendly code snippets from a qbk documentation file into separate files
generate_definitions_before_docs: generate documentation files showing all definitions accumulated before each section of the guide
